summary.text: Christie Craig is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia for District 19, serving since 2024. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Education and Health, General Laws and Technology, and Rules.

paragraphs.text: Christie New Craig was born in Portsmouth, Virginia, on February 8, 1967, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says she attended the University of Virginia's Sorensen Institute for Political Leadership, graduated from the Chesapeake Police Academy, and lists her occupation as consultant.

The page lists her memberships as including the Fraternal Order of Police and the Chesapeake Task Force on Aging, and lists a 2012 Virginia National Guard Bronze Star Medal for Exceptional Service among her awards.
